result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but the promotional banner has a serious text-contrast problem: white heading and subtext on a pale green background are very hard to read. Other elements (carousels clipped at the right edge, card cut off at the bottom) are expected scroll/viewport behavior and not counted as defects.

issues.description: In the '3 free deliveries for you' promo banner, the white heading and the 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' subtext sit on a light mint-green background, producing very low contrast that fails readability/WCAG contrast guidelines.
issues.suggestion: Use a darker green background or switch the text to a dark color (e.g., dark green/near-black) so the heading and subtext meet at least 4.5:1 contrast ratio.

issues.description: The promo banner's 'Order now' button and text block are vertically offset toward the bottom of the banner, leaving a large empty area at the top and making the banner feel unbalanced.
issues.suggestion: Vertically center the text and CTA button within the banner, or reduce the banner height to match the content.
